name: Bad Oeynhausen (Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of blue, white and blue with a broad white middle stripe, charged at the centre with the city arms of Bad Oeynhausen (a white ladder on blue below three swans on red).
history: Municipal flag of Bad Oeynhausen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Bad Oeynhausen arms — ladder and swans
